review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: reduce repeated reads without changing polling or notification cadence
review.notes: Read-only four-sample live baseline suggests serve and tmux rather than the SwiftUI menu process dominate this product CPU. Static source confirms SSE GatherAgents bypasses the REST snapshot and a single Codex gather can capture frames more than once. Fix only reuse: force fresh producer on every existing SSE tick while atomically publishing its bounded JSON under the existing lock; keep REST fallback/TTL/scoping/failure semantics. Memoize frame locally per gather, never persist across polls or suppress permissions. Tests count actual producer/capture calls and preserve changed-frame behavior, not timing-dependent sleeps. No claimed battery percentage from synthetic counts or un-symbolicated live sample; no deployed-service restart. Production CPU comparison needs a later installed version under equivalent load.

cases.description: Producer publishes one bounded immutable REST snapshot without suppressing fresh SSE scans
cases.setup: Isolated snapshotCache, fake clock/load counters and concurrent callers; two scope homes; oversized and failed publication
cases.action: Refresh producer then read REST concurrently, advance time, force next producer update, change scope and fail/oversize loader
cases.expected: One production collection per producer tick, no extra REST collections within freshness; explicit next producer bypasses TTL; clone ownership preserved; failure/oversize never turns stale bytes into success; scopes never cross

cases.description: One frame per pane per gather preserves approval/status behavior and reloads next pass
cases.setup: Actual GatherAgents under existing synthetic HOME/pane/process seams; multiple Codex panes; synthetic capture counter and changed next frame
cases.action: Run full gather and repeat with numbered permission menu; verify counts and statuses
cases.expected: Frame probes within one pass share exact text; each pane is captured at most once, no frame survives into next gather; new approval becomes waiting without invented done; unrelated non-Codex states retained

cases.description: Actual SSE adapter publishes the same full roster for REST including role and native identity
cases.setup: Actual serveAgentStatuses plus producer seam/cache fixture, synthetic records and no real tmux
cases.action: Invoke exact adapter, then concurrent REST dependency; inspect projection and collection counts
cases.expected: SSE uses fresh producer, REST reads its cache rather than second gather; role/completion/follow/native identity unchanged; no real services/power settings touched
